# Alignment Syntax

## Default Alignment

| A | B | C |
| --- | --- | --- |
| left | middle | right |
| short | mid | longish right |
| wider left value | wider middle value | r |

## Explicit Left Alignment

| A | B | C |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| left | middle | right |
| short | mid | longish right |
| wider left value | wider middle value | r |

## Right Alignment

| A | B | C |
| ---: | ---: | ---: |
| left | middle | right |
| short | mid | longish right |
| wider left value | wider middle value | r |

## Center Alignment

| A | B | C |
| :---: | :---: | :---: |
| left | middle | right |
| short | mid | longish right |
| wider left value | wider middle value | r |

## Mixed Alignment

| Left | Right | Center |
| :--- | ---: | :---: |
| a | b | c |
| leftish | rightish | centered |
| widest left cell | widest right cell | widest center cell |

## Minimum Delimiters

| A | B | C |
| :- | -: | :-: |
| 1 | 2 | 3 |
| alpha | beta | gamma |
| longer left value | longer right value | longer center value |

## Long Delimiters

| A | B | C |
| :---------- | ----------: | :----------: |
| 1 | 2 | 3 |
| alpha | beta | gamma |
| longer left value | longer right value | longer center value |
